draft.text: You came in because you have right knee pain after slipping and falling on your property about a week ago.
You feel pain when moving your knee up and down.
You heard a pop when you fell and have some swelling.
There is no deformity, instability, or locking in your knee.
You have no numbness, tingling, or weakness in your leg or foot.
An X-ray showed no broken bones or bony problems.
The doctor said you did not break anything.
The next steps will be discussed later.

unverified_summary.text: You came in because you have been having right knee pain for about a week after slipping and falling on your property.
You said the pain is worse when moving your knee up and down and when putting pressure on it.
You felt something pop when you fell and have some swelling in your knee.
You have not had any deformity, instability, or locking in your knee since the injury.
You also have not had any numbness, tingling, or weakness in your leg or foot.
The next steps will be discussed.
